title: Boundary diagrams of normalized compatible short exact systems
statement: Fix a small filtered category J, a diagram of small sites F with finite-cover precoverages P, a colimit site cocone V with precoverage Q, continuous cover-preserving canonical and transition functors preserving covering pullbacks, exact set inverse images and additive abelian inverse images, Ext groups, and coefficient-natural cohomology pullbacks commuting with connecting maps and having the degree-zero unit formula. Fix inverse-image composition isomorphisms e,eV with the adjunction-unit equations, original compatible coefficients Fs,φ, their inverse-image diagram S and colimit K, an index i, X_i, degree n≥0, the degree n+1 diagram D and canonical cocone c with the specified object, Arrow and endpoint equations [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Fix normalized coefficients As,θ, a compatible projection pA:Fs→As that is invertible after canonical inverse image and on the specified degree n+1 stage groups; injective middle and cokernel systems Gs,ψ and Rs,ρ; compatible stage short exact sequences 0→As→Gs→Rs→0; cohomological identity laws for ψ and ρ in all degrees; their inverse-image diagrams U,T, colimits M,L, and a short exact sequence K.pt→M.pt→L.pt with the embedding and quotient colimit-leg equations [lem-weil-pbc-colimit-sites-short-exact-systems]. Then form degree n diagrams B,E and canonical cocones b,d with all specified object, transition, leg and endpoint equations. There are natural transformations α:B→E and δ:E→D, and maps α₀:b.pt→d.pt and β:d.pt→c.pt. Each δ component is surjective; each α component followed by δ is zero; both comparison squares commute. After transport by hbpt,hdpt,hcpt, α₀ is Yoneda composition with mk₀ g₀ and β is Yoneda composition with the target short exact sequence's extension class. No target kernel-image conclusion is asserted. All equations and hypotheses are written explicitly in the Lean record; witnesses are in continuation form.

source.place: Tags 09YP (lemma-colim-sites-cohomology) and 0739 (lemma-colim-works-over-collection), the two-row exact diagram; 0EXZ (lemma-colim-sites-injective)

proof.text: Identify the supplied pullbacks with canonical cohomology pullbacks by uniqueness from the degree-zero unit formula, naturality and connecting compatibility. Use composition, the coefficient cocycles and cohomological identity laws to form B,E and their canonical cocones.

Use the stage quotient and connecting morphisms, transporting the latter back along the degree n+1 projection isomorphisms. Naturality gives α and δ; Ext exactness and injective vanishing give the zero composition and stage surjectivity.

Define the target maps from g₀ and the target extension class and transport endpoints. Naturality and connecting compatibility with the colimit-leg equations give both squares and the two explicit Yoneda-product formulas.
